mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate below 0.2% signals an active monetary easing cycle that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as observed in historical policy shifts.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when FEDFUNDS remains below 0.2%, or Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window falls below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in unemployment rate above 5.5% signals deteriorating labor market conditions that precedes corporate earnings contraction, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as investors react to near-term economic weakness.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 5.5% for 3 consecutive months, or Rank IC over 2-year window remains below 0.04.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate broad-based consumer demand contraction, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as the market prices in recessionary risks.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS decline by >1% monthly, or Rank IC over 3-year window falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production above 105 signals robust supply-side expansion that precedes strong corporate earnings growth, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days during high-supply regimes.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when INDPRO exceeds 105, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling window remains below 0.04.

mechanism_narrative: CPIAUCSL index above 270 signals persistent high inflation that triggers hawkish monetary policy expectations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as investors price in rate hikes.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL exceeds 270, or Rank IC over 2-year window falls below 0.04.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in payroll employment (PAYEMS) and rising unemployment (UNRATE) indicate labor market contraction that reduces consumer spending capacity, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when PAYEMS declines and UNRATE rises, or Rank IC over 3-year window falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts below 1600 thousand units signals weakening consumer demand for housing, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as the market prices in economic slowdown risks.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when HOUST falls below 1600, or Rank IC over 2-year window remains below 0.04.

mechanism_narrative: Sustained industrial production above 100 indicates robust supply-side activity that supports corporate earnings growth, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as observed in expansionary cycles.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when INDPRO remains above 100, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling window falls below 0.05.
